selection: Accept independent antenna-baseline guard only; reject uncalibrated uncertainty gate.
protocol: Known-truth synthetic tests and all 33 train representatives (2 off-map) determined selection. All 13 validation and public fused reference were checked afterward. No reference is passed to runtime.

accepted_rule.effect: Clear both pending longitudinal correction windows and branch evidence on inconsistent pair; leave velocity and integrated wheel distance untouched.

rejected_rule: In addition to pair guard, gate lone-antenna innovation by 3*sqrt(4+Estimator.distance_variance), after branch evidence. Estimator distance variance does not account for all systematic wheel or anchor errors; gate blocks real recovery.

preserved_behaviors: single-antenna repair after gradual acceleration and 2% wheel scale drift
fast motion with 0.19 s antenna timestamp skew

frame_scoring_fix.rule: Score only valid finite mgrs_37UCB positions; report null RMSE if none. Absolute coverage denominator includes every proxy-matched publication, including relative or invalid outputs. Diagnostic frozen replay must preserve every original output field exactly.

public_reference_postselection.interpretation: Essentially unchanged; the existing branch/elevation improvement is preserved. Not used for selection.

limitations: No physically inconsistent pair can be detected when only one antenna is supplied; the known lone-rover validation regression remains unchanged.
A common GNSS shift preserving antenna separation is not observable from pair geometry alone.
Paired-GNSS scoring proxy is not the official fused-reference score.
Only two train recording dates and one validation date are available; bag counts do not imply independent sessions.
Map-free relative outputs deliberately remain unscored in absolute position RMSE and reduce absolute coverage.
